2: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.
3: You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah
4: You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.
5: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.
6: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?
7: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?
8: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.
9: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.
10: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.
11: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.
12: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
13: The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.
14: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.
